◆ lowPwrStateTransCmd

rlUInt16_t rlPowerSaveModeCfg_t::lowPwrStateTransCmd

Low power state transition commands are defined as below
Mode Definition
0 RESERVED
1 ENTER_RF_PWR_DOWN, device enters RF power down state from normal active state.
2 EXIT_RF_PWR_DOWN, device exits the RF power down state back to its previous state.
3-65535 RESERVED
.

Note
: Values other than 1 and 2 are not supported in xWR6243 device. It is not recommended to configure other values in this field, it can cause the device to be in undesirable state.
